description: Retrieve reported historical SDWA violations for a PWSID or reported legal-entity state, optionally narrowed by county, contaminant, category or compliance flags. Dates mean inclusive compliance-period overlap, not sampling dates; either known endpoint can establish overlap, while indeterminate overlap is excluded and reported. Monitoring/reporting violations may have no measured concentration. Missing records do not establish current compliance or water safety. Set stage true to acquire a bounded analytical partition, retaining every continuation before drawing complete conclusions.

canvas_id.description: Existing explicit canvas capability; accepted only with stage true.

category.description: Exact violation-category code; preserves monitoring/reporting distinctions.

compliance_status.description: Exact source compliance-status code, not a current safety verdict.

contaminant.description: Exact SDWIS contaminant code or lead, arsenic, nitrate, TTHM; lead selects 1030 and Lead and Copper Rule code 5000, including copper/monitoring records; not a UCMR family selector.

county.description: County served, requiring state; terminal County is ignored for matching, never inferred from operator address.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool; retain exactly the original selectors.

date_from.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss lower date, normalized to its calendar day; violations/LCR require known endpoints to establish period overlap, actions use enforcement date and UCMR collection date.

date_to.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss upper date, normalized to its calendar day; either known period endpoint can establish overlap, while indeterminate overlap is excluded and reported.

health_based.description: Filter the source Y/N health-based indicator; unknown indicators are not false.

limit.description: Inline items requested; values above the effective maximum 100 are clamped with a notice.

pwsid.description: Exact nine-character alphanumeric PWSID from sdwis_search_water_systems; numeric tribal prefixes and alphabetic suffixes are valid.

record_cursor.description: Signed oversized-record pointer returned by this same tool; use with view text.

stage.description: Acquire and stage a bounded source partition; requires enabled DataCanvas.

stage_max_rows.description: Partition row request; above 25000 is clamped with a notice. Twenty upstream pages per call still bound acquisition.

state.description: Reported WATER_SYSTEM legal-entity postal state or territory name/code; not a physical service boundary.

view.description: Records by default; text reads an oversized record losslessly using record_cursor.

name: sdwis_get_violations

pointer.description: Executable next steps for the canvas capability.

source_complete.description: Whether this staged partition contains the entire selected source.

effective_filters.description: Normalized effective selection; state_basis identifies legal-entity state matching.

encoding.description: Concatenated text is the exact serialized JSON record.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `selection_capacity_exhausted`: Live selections or retained source data reached the process capacity. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: Canvas admission, operation queue, table or row capacity is full. `invalid_selector`: PWSID/state missing or selectors are incompatible. `unknown_contaminant`: Contaminant is not an exact supported alias or code. `cursor_invalid`: Continuation expired or changed filters. `source_changed`: EPA metadata shifted within a retrieval. `upstream_contract_changed`: EPA table no longer matches verified public schema. `upstream_paging_changed`: EPA source paging does not progress. `canvas_disabled`: Staging was requested without a real configured canvas. `item_too_large`: A complete row exceeds the inline response budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: Whether the indicated continuation has more work.

items.description: Complete public source rows, never truncated strings.
Flat allowlisted source fields; null represents unknown source data.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation pointing at the first unconsumed item or source work.

offset.description: Unicode code-point offset of this chunk.

published_release.description: Publisher release label, distinct from HTTP modification and observation dates.

retrieved_at.description: HTTP retrieval time, not observation or snapshot time.

record_identity.description: Identity of the oversized record being read.

returned.description: Items in this response, not a total.

selection_partition.description: Delivered source position; membership-only work has no position.

final_partition.description: Final source partition when exhaustion is known; otherwise null.

selection_id.description: Stable identity of this source retrieval.

source_complete.description: All selected source rows are contained in this output or its current staged partition; false after earlier rows were delivered.

truncated.description: True when this inline preview omits retained or unfetched source rows; follow the exact continuation or live dataset.

title: Sdwis Get Violations
